title: Customer-data processing inventory is incomplete
description: The supplied inventory does not reconcile all products vendors data categories and processing locations.

title: Encryption evidence is incomplete for analytics stores
description: Management reports encryption but complete configuration and key-management evidence was not supplied for several analytics stores.

title: Critical data processors have stale assessments
description: Several vendors processing customer information have missing or stale security assessments.

title: Customer contract security obligations are not centrally mapped
description: Security and notification commitments are maintained across commercial teams without a complete central obligations register.

title: Vendor incident evidence remains incomplete
description: A synthetic vendor-related notification is under review and chronology scope and customer impact are not yet corroborated.

title: Retention deletion evidence varies across repositories
description: Deletion controls and evidence differ across customer analytics repositories and backup locations.

title: Cross-border transfer records require legal validation
description: Transfer-mechanism and location records require reconciliation for selected subprocessors.

title: Third-party access reviews are incomplete
description: Periodic reviews do not cover all vendor identities with access to customer-data environments.

title: Cloud data-loss monitoring coverage is inconsistent
description: Monitoring policies differ across cloud environments holding synthetic customer information.
